title: 1974 return to France and New York, and her father's death
summary: After a trip home she returned to France in 1974 for her own tour, then worked briefly at a New York club and Barney Josephson's New Year's Eve party. While she was there her father died.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
